title: A Phone Call Before a Difficult Surgery
script: Rafi: [nervous] Mom, they are taking me to surgery in one hour. I am scared.
Mother: [gently] I know, my son. It is okay to feel scared. That is a normal feeling.
Rafi: [worried] What if something goes wrong during the operation?
Mother: [calmly] The doctors are skilled, and they have prepared carefully. But you are right, we cannot control everything.
Rafi: [quietly] That's the part that scares me the most, not being in control.
Mother: [warmly] I understand completely. But remember, you were never fully in control, not even on an ordinary day.
Rafi: [thoughtful] I never really thought about it that way before.
Mother: [gently] Allah has always been holding your life, even when you felt in control. Today is not so different.
Rafi: [softly] I want to believe that, Mom. I really do.
Mother: [gently] It takes practice, my son. I still remind myself of it too, even now.
Rafi: [curious] Does it ever get easier, this trusting part?
Mother: [honestly] A little, with time. But mostly, you just keep choosing it, again and again, every time you feel afraid.
Mother: [encouraging] Say a small prayer before they take you in. Ask for ease, and trust the rest to Allah.
Rafi: [determined] Okay. I will do that. Thank you for staying on the phone with me.
Mother: [with love] I am praying for you right now, and I will be here the moment you wake up.
Rafi: [relieved] That helps more than you know. I feel a little calmer already.
Mother: [warmly] Good. Breathe slowly, my son. Allah is with you.
Rafi: [softly] I love you, Mom. I'll see you when I wake up.
Mother: [with love] I love you too, my son. I will be right there, waiting.
